content: .{@-अङ्गुलम्@} a measure equal to the middle digit of the middle finger in the right hand of the architect or priest, employed in measuring the sacrificial objects like the kuśa grass or seat, the spout of a ladle, and the ladle <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Suprabhedāgama 30. 4/5</ls>, <ls n="Suprabhedāgama 30.">7/8</ls>.
